title: Venser | Planeswalker
description: Read Venser's biography: an artificer from Urborg on the plane of Dominaria, he's a brilliant inventor able to think fast on his feet.

paragraphs.text: Venser is a brilliant inventor able to think fast on his feet. He wields blue and white magic, building unique and powerful artifacts with an emphasis on teleportation. Venser’s talent eventually ignited his spark, making him a Planeswalker and giving him direct access to the planes beyond the boundaries of Dominaria. Relying on his knowledge of artifice and teleportation, Venser now travels the universe, satisfying his boundless curiosity of all things mechanical along the way.
